_comment: Authoritative DCS unit type catalog, pulled live from the DCS MCP server's list_unit_types tool (backed by pydcs) on 2026-10-15. This is every unit type DCS/pydcs knows about across vehicle, plane, helicopter, and ship -- covers both coalitions, since pydcs does not tag units by country. Re-run export_catalog.py after a DCS update to pick up new units (new modules add new types from time to time).
